description: Poem Generator is a browser-based block-programming microworld created by Craig Jenkins using BYOB/Snap!
title: Poem Generator

description: PoETA is a curated toolbox framework developed by Lucciarini and Boniwell for integrating brief, stand-alone, flexible positive-psychology interventions into mainstream classrooms with minimal specialised training.
title: PoETA

description: POGIL is a guided-inquiry instructional programme and activity design model developed and supported by The POGIL Project for collaborative content learning and process-skill development across disciplines.
title: POGIL (Process Oriented Guided Inquiry Learning)

description: A historical Ohio State University academic-standing index that weights registrar-recorded grades by credit hours and divides total points by total credited hours.
title: Point-hour ratio

description: A 16-item questionnaire adapted and validated by Zalewska and colleagues for Polish undergraduate nursing students to measure the presence and perceived importance of educational practices in high-fidelity simulation.
title: Polish adaptation of the Educational Practices Questionnaire (EPQ)

description: A large anonymized multimodal dataset of more than 100,000 hours of longitudinal one-on-one project-based tutoring interactions between PhD-level mentors and K–12 or pre-college students, collected and maintained by Polygence.
title: Polygence authentic learning dataset

description: A researcher-developed music-education performance assessment by Hamit Yokus for measuring undergraduate students' competency in performing specified polyrhythmic structures.
title: Polyrhythmic Tapping Test

description: PomeLog is an observer-based software tool developed by de la Fuente Rene et al.
title: PomeLog

description: Two researcher-developed assessments using non-routine mathematics problems and a four-stage scoring rubric to measure 9th-grade students’ mathematical performance and problem-solving approaches.
title: PÖÖ1 and PÖÖ2 performance measurement tools based on non-routine problems

description: A pooled correlation-matrix dataset of Chinese-speaking children's cognitive-linguistic skills and word-reading outcomes, released by the study authors through an OSF repository.
title: Pooled correlational dataset of 288 independent samples (N = 47,121) with OSF repository

description: A 30-item four-choice achievement test developed by Akbaş et al.
title: Population in our Country Academic Achievement Test (PCAAT)

description: PoseBlocks is an AI-powered, Scratch-based browser programming platform developed by Randi Williams and colleagues for building movement- and pose-interactive projects with real-time recognition blocks and custom recognition models.
title: PoseBlocks

description: A K–12 curriculum developed and delivered by Positive Action, Inc.
title: Positive Action

description: PBIS is an evidence-based, multitiered framework used by schools to organize data, systems, and behavioral practices through universal, targeted, and individualized supports.
title: Positive Behavioral Interventions and Supports (PBIS)

description: The University of Chicago Consortium on School Research's Post-secondary Attainment Index is a district-level indicator combining high-school graduation, college enrollment, and college-completion rates to estimate post-secondary attainment for CPS students.
title: Post-secondary Attainment Index (PAI)

description: A framework operationalizing initial suicide-bereavement support for health students and primary-health-care professionals through welcoming, health-care, and organizational-monitoring objectives and observable OSCE behaviors.
title: Postvention framework

description: A Youth Sport Trust and University of Exeter programme that trains school teachers, using sports-coaching techniques and cascade dissemination, to provide focused feedback conversations to secondary pupils.
title: Powerful Learning Conversations (PLC)

description: PowerSchool's attendance-intervention platform integrates attendance data into dashboards and supports educator-to-family messaging to help schools monitor and improve student attendance.
title: PowerSchool Attendance Intervention
